text: The Patriots head to Jacksonville for a Week 3 AFC showdown against the Jaguars, but they're traveling with some notable roster adjustments and injury concerns that could impact their offensive line and secondary; safety Dell Pettus has been placed on injured reserve while linebacker Jose Ramirez was signed to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and linebacker Benton Whitley joined the practice squad, and most significantly, starting right guard Mike Onwenu's broken right ankle represents a potential long-term concern for New England's protection scheme. Rookie tight end Eli Raridon has returned to practice, offering a modest bright spot as the team monitors his status for Sunday's matchup, while the Patriots must also tighten their clock management before halftime after two straight games featuring questionable decision-making late in the second quarter. The Jaguars, coming off their worst offensive performance in eleven months, are expecting a favorable response against a Patriots team that offensive coordinator says is still "finding ourselves," though New England's gameplan will specifically target Jacksonville's Cover-6 coverage and build on their "X" plays to exploit defensive vulnerabilities.
